name: IceCube-Gen2
summary: The proposed next-generation South Pole observatory would combine a much larger optical array, a surface veto and a radio array to extend neutrino astronomy from TeV to EeV energies.
detection_principle: Optical sensors in deep ice reconstruct Cherenkov light, while shallow radio stations detect coherent Askaryan pulses from higher-energy showers. The surface component helps identify cosmic-ray backgrounds.

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: A future expansion described by the project and science white paper; the full Gen2 array is not equivalent to the completed IceCube Upgrade.

timeline.event: IceCube Upgrade deployed as a technology and calibration step toward Gen2.

key_parameters.value: Combined optical and radio programme from TeV to EeV scales

results.summary: Projected source and diffuse-flux sensitivities motivate the expansion; they are not Gen2 detections.

science_scope: Parameters refer to the named apparatus or explicitly identified design phase. Projections describe sensitivity goals and are not observations.
